meaning.en: CEE red socket (IEC 60309-2, 3P+N+E, 400 V three-phase, 16 to 125 A, earth at 6 h), shown as the socket face seen from the front
meaning.de: CEE-Steckdose rot (IEC 60309-2, 3P+N+E, 400 V Drehstrom, „Starkstrom“, 16 bis 125 A, Schutzkontakt auf 6 Uhr), dargestellt als Steckdosenfläche von vorn

standard.source: IEC 60309-2 itself not consulted. Layout checked against the public drawing "File:IEC 60309-2 16-20A 3P+N+E socket.svg" on Wikimedia Commons by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0), retrieved 2026-11-03, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:IEC_60309-2_16-20A_3P%2BN%2BE_socket.svg (socket end view; only ratios to the opening radius used, so the drawing's scale does not matter): opening r 23.2 around the centre, contacts on a circle r 13.25 (0.571 R), earth r 4.1 at 6 h, the four other contacts r 2.9 at ±72° and ±144° from earth, the key nose r 5.5 at 6 h on the housing (r 30.65). The earth position relative to the key encodes the voltage ("File:IEC 60309-2 connector clock diagram.svg", same author): 6 h is 400 V for 3P+N+E. The 16 A drawing stands for all currents up to 125 A; the larger sizes keep the arrangement. Drawn: outline circle R 9 around (12, 12) for the opening, as for plug-schuko; the key as an outward bump of radius 2 at 6 h (arc between (10.1, 20.797) and (13.9, 20.797), centre (12, 20.173), bottom at y 22.17), because the housing and the drawing's nose lie outside the canvas. Contact positions are the drawing's scaled to R 9 (the drawing's R is 23.2): earth ring at (12, 17.14), the other four rings at (7.111, 13.588), (16.889, 13.588), (8.979, 7.842) and (15.021, 7.842). Contact sizes: earth r 1.75, the others r 1.25, the same as in plug-cee-blue; the drawing scales to r 1.59 and 1.125. Socket face exception (design guide section 5): in EV charging the IEC 60309 socket is a supply socket (campsites, farms, mobile charging cables), not a vehicle inlet.
